title: Process Context via manual event subscriber pattern
summary: Adds community knowledge article documenting how to expose process context to extensions using manual event subscriber bindings tied to variable scope instead of singleton flags that persist across failed transactions.
key_points: Explains the anti-pattern of using SingleInstance booleans that remain true after rollback
Describes the safe pattern using manually bound local internal events with public query procedures
Shows that manual binding lifetime is tied to variable scope, unwinding on errors
Provides both good and bad code samples illustrating the pattern
Documents approach currently used in ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL integrations
quote: A manual binding is the safe carrier: its lifetime is tied to a variable's scope
